[agent] Janitor: the hourly issue and discussion janitor rewrites this log each run. It shows the last run, the actions it took with a reason for each, a rolling list of recent actions, deferred candidates, and anything that needs a human. The routine writes it to the `janitor/ledger` branch, and a workflow on that branch applies it here.

## Last run
2026-10-05 13:35 UTC on origin/main `6811b4e7`. 277 open issues and 34 open PRs were reviewed. Since `045d7ec7`, 46 PRs merged (2026-10-05 11:13–13:20Z), and most of the issues they fix auto-closed.

## This run
- **Issues closed (3):** #473 (PR #625), #566 (PR #611) and #603 (PR #605). In each case the PR said "Fixes #A and #B", but GitHub auto-closed only the first issue. Each fix was verified on origin/main (code plus a regression test named for the issue).
- **Not closed, partial fix:** #742 and #650. PR #743 says only "Refs" and fixes the hosted re-pin. The vendored re-scan is still unfixed, so both have a comment. Their claim is under 48h old and stays in place.
- **Labels fixed:** removed `agent:claimed` from 49 closed issues: #325, #340, #356, #360, #363, #473, #557, #562, #566, #571, #577, #588, #592, #601, #603, #606, #608, #609, #613, #626, #636, #640, #659, #661, #662, #664, #665, #670, #674, #687, #694, #695, #696, #697, #699, #718, #720, #732, #739, #754, #765, #779, #786, #788, #790, #803, #806, #817, #821, #838. Every bughunt issue has its `pm:*` label.
- **Claims released:** none. Every open claim maps to an open PR or is under 48h old. The Gradle batch (`2026-10-02T13:56:32Z-gradle21`) is about 72h old, but its PR #646 is open and was updated today. #823 and #728 were claimed today and have no PR yet.
- **Discussion ops:** drift comments on ledgers #306, #307, #308, #309, #310, #311, #312, #313, #314 and #316, which still cite issues closed today as `fail`. Ledgers #302, #303, #304 and #305 were refreshed on `4646693` after the merges, so they were skipped. One drift comment on #575 (hatch gap note). No PM has two ledgers.
- **Checked and kept open:** #826 (the `;`-joined gem line has no `;` check in `gem_line_tail_blocks_edit`, `patch/redirect/mod.rs:5226`), #536 (`takeover_capable` in `scan/hosted.rs:1617` still excludes `pkg:composer/`), #737 (the Berry bug hunt re-confirmed it on `4646693` after #719), #780 (the refactor is still pending after #805), and #723 (uv-specific; #708 gated only requirements.txt). #784–#859 are not duplicates of each other or of closed issues. #852 is a new `install-strategy=linked` alias case that #738 doesn't cover, and #853 and #854 have different triggers.
